title: Safe and Sound
style: Drift phonk with aggressive 148 BPM swing, pounding sub drops, syncopated trap drums, acid lead stabs, cowbell hooks, and cinematic chase percussion; verse rides tense and sparse with filtered sirens and spoken male rap textures, pre-chorus strips to bass pulse and rising noise, chorus hits with wide melodic doubles and gang chants, bridge opens on reverse sweeps and tire-screech fills before final lift. Close-mic aggressive male vocals, shouted ad-libs, delay throws on hook words, bright punchy and high-impact mix., world, stylized, natural, rap, theme, hollywood, soundtrack, steady
lyrics:
[Intro]
Bank break
got the loot now run, run, run!
go go go!
Safe and sound
Sirens, police chatter
Safe and Sound
Unit 48 — all good

[Verse 1]
Acid adrenalin pumping
Heart bass drum stomping
Conductor Mind
Next move to find
Guard got up, spin and drop
Roll upside down without a frown
As that clown will take you down
Driver ready, hands steady
Mirror eyes, here’s my guys!

[Chorus]
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Drive, driver, drive!
We all get home tonight
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
No one left behind
We all get home tonight

[Verse 2]
Watch out, Pig Truck!
Driver drifts then push
No bacon tonight
Pigs safe and sound
Big black hearse truck
Means only one thing
Rest in peace, no releases
Sirens blare, drive no care
Cops are here, pigs I care

[Pre-Chorus]
Driver spins, no pig skin
Big black truck, driver takes the tyre out
Pigs freed, safe and sound
Cops on the back, driver stop!

[Chorus]
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Drive, driver, drive!
We all get home tonight
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
No one left behind
We all get home tonight

[Bridge]
The driver drifts, sneaky sneaky
Phonk slides, Panthera pounce
Shades the move, pork little piggies almost got smacked
On the G4 delta Track

[Verse 3]
Bumble Bee bytes
Bits and bits of bytes
Flying paths right
Driver eyes, eyes of the night
Round and round, almost upside down
We did 360, spin around
Reverse, reverse, reverse
3 mirrors and they’re in front
Driver’s viral stunts, safe and sound
Math driver has us, safe and sound

[Final Chorus]
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Drive, driver, drive!
We all get home tonight
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
No one left behind
We all get home tonight

[Outro]
Driver got us home
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
